title: Jealousy
summary: Jealousy is the fear of losing someone or something important to another person. Mild jealousy is a normal emotion; controlling behaviour driven by jealousy is not okay.
do: Name the feeling and talk calmly
Look at what insecurity is underneath
dont: Check their phone or restrict who they see
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
